LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult01.title: Think Tank Analyst
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult01.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the senior analysts at the fleet's intelligence think tank. After confirming vital intelligence that could have prevented a war and getting nowhere reporting it to command, [PAWN_pronoun] gravely broke regulations and took the files to try to stop the war in person. The war still claimed many lives.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult02.title: Signals Interpreter
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult02.description: [PAWN_nameDef] translated intercepted, encrypted local communications for fleet intelligence. The two warring factions had in fact drafted the same ceasefire terms, but fleet command would not let the locals realize their encryption was useless against the fleet, so the fighting went on until neither side could fight any longer. After that, [PAWN_nameDef] made up [PAWN_possessive] mind.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult03.title: Fleet Epidemic Officer
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult03.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tracked outbreaks for the fleet's medical department. After a fever spread between two factions and left the dead strewn everywhere, and with [PAWN_possessive] superiors unmoved, [PAWN_nameDef] defected to the surface with the files, hoping to heal the people of the rim with restricted medical technology from the sealed archives.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult04.title: Orbital Survey Analyst
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult04.description: [PAWN_nameDef] interpreted weather survey data on colonial worlds for the fleet. After foreseeing a megadrought a full season ahead, [PAWN_nameDef] took the archive, survey data included, broke the accords to land on the colony world without leave, and tried to trade the intelligence for the locals' support.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult05.title: SAGE Maintenance Technician
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult05.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the maintenance team leads for the SAGE system. After watching a border clash predicted by the node in [PAWN_possessive] charge grow into all-out war, [PAWN_nameDef] vanished with the node's archive during a routine ground inspection.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult06.title: Refugee Protector
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantAdult06.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once a promising young officer in the colonial fleet. While carrying out [PAWN_possessive] missions, [PAWN_nameDef] took in many local refugees and orphans, but on finding that [PAWN_possessive] supplies could not feed them all, [PAWN_pronoun] turned to forbidden biotechnology for personal reasons.
